Hi Wang,

I am afraid I cannot provide a quick answer to this as reviewing GGIR output and parameter settings involves various steps, including a good understanding of study protocol and other experimental conditions. For that reason we offer some training options https://www.accelting.com/ggir-training/ 

However, if you have more specific questions or concerns then feel free to post them here in the google group.

Vincent
